label: Pixel Scramble
blurb: Blocks the picture into big pixels and shuffles them around, like a scrambled or encrypted frame. Keep the shuffle local and it stays readable (a privacy mosaic you can still roughly make out); open it up and the blocks scatter across the whole frame into noise. Scramble shuffles the blocks every which way, or shift whole rows or columns instead. Amount mixes from a clean pixelation up to the full scramble, and the seed re-rolls the shuffle (hit a new seed to re-randomize).
